coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Vyas 2025: every result is a derivation under stated assumptions or a sketch. Wang 2023 (TNMP): the three stated limits stay HIGH; exactness is argued, not proved. Wang 2024 (noisy kernels): the stated limit of the yellow regions stays HIGH; Theorems III.1 and III.5, Lemma III.2 and Corollary III.4 are cut before bounds that the two-column text layer prints flat, and the kernel form is a garbled derivation. Wang 2025 (regression): every result is a derivation or an estimate, and the abstract and the appendix disagree on the read-out error. Wang 2025 (amplitude encoding): Theorem 1, Lemma 1 and Proposition 2 stay HIGH; Proposition 1's condition is garbled, Proposition 3's condition as printed cannot hold for densities, and the distinguishability inequality is quoted only in part. Exponents printed flat are not counted as lost symbols
